description:
Stop memorizing architecture diagrams and start learning the process. In this video, I break down the exact 6-step framework I’ve used to clear technical interviews at companies like Microsoft and Cineplex. We won't just talk theory—we are going to perform a super deep dive and Design Instagram from scratch using this repeatable template.

Timestamps:
Introduction: 00:00:00
Clarify Requirements : 00:00:57
API design, low level design: 00:14:51
High-Level Design: 00:43:11
Tradeoffs and improvements: 01:12:28
Final message: 01:15:09

What you'll learn
I walk you through every critical phase of a Senior-level interview:

Step 1: Clarifying Requirements – Defining the "Happy Path" and setting non-functional goals like 99.99% availability.

Step 2: API & Data Flow – Designing RESTful contracts and choosing between JSON and Protobuf.

Step 3: High-Level Design – Mapping out Load Balancers, S3 Object Storage, and CDNs.

Step 4: Deep Dive – Scaling with Database Sharding and solving the "Hardest Problem": Cache Invalidation.

Step 5: Scalability & Bottlenecks – Solving the "Justin Bieber Effect" (The Celebrity Problem) with Hybrid Fan-out.

Step 6: Trade-offs – Understanding the CAP Theorem and why we choose Eventual Consistency for social media.

Huge thanks for all the support, everyone! My aim is to provide free education for all, and I’m committed to keeping my videos free forever.

If you find these videos useful and have the means to support the channel’s growth, please consider becoming a member. Your support helps me keep creating and improving this content for the whole community. Either way, I’m just glad you’re here!
